certification.name: UMBC Principles of Cybersecurity MicroMasters Program
certification.description: Three courses from the University of Maryland Baltimore County (USMx) covering identity and access management, cryptography, network attacks, mobile, IoT and cloud security, digital forensics and governance. Course-based MicroMasters credential with no single proctored exam.
certification.currency_note: Program bundle price $672.30 shown on the edX page (list $747 for the courses bought separately); one-off payment, not a subscription.
